test_sequence: Use a battery simulator and current-limited bench supply; no real cell for fault sweeps.
Start10kohm; verify gate and charge behavior, then increase to47kohm and sweep back through cold recovery.
Return10kohm; decrease to4.7kohm and sweep back through hot recovery.
Record measured resistance, BAT_TS, both reference voltages, rail, guard gate and charge current for each transition.
Repeat open/short sensor faults and power-up/brownout cases.
acceptance: Stop transitions must inhibit charging and recovery must not oscillate. Numeric thresholds remain provisional until actual common-mode comparator error, sensor R-T bounds and cell thermal lag are resolved.
limits: Comparator extrema taken from datasheet test conditions; actual common-mode bound not established.
Beta approximation and independent1% tolerances are only a screening model.
No physical results or charge-safety approval.
